name: 砂漠のサボテン
notes: Three joined upward-curving arms, rounded tips, shallow ribs, green skin and weathered root retain the source reference.
Browser comparison rejected the coarser first revision and retained the normal-transfer experiment as revision 02. The final revision preserves more source surface in both close and distant LODs.
Seven exact neutral and clay views, source/candidate browser comparison, and five model copies reviewed. The mesh is a visual game asset, not a watertight fabrication solid.
Original UV/albedo and approximately 2.4-metre proportions retained; dielectric roughness 0.78. LOD gates are 35 and 80 metres beyond the model footprint. Static model without rig or animation.

provenance.reconstruction: Local TRELLIS-2; preserved dense reconstruction, source-derived reduction and separate revisions.
